extraction.disclaimer_span: We do not offer every plan available in your area. Currently we represent 26 organizations which offer 3,740 products in your area. Please contact Medicare.gov or 1-800-MEDICARE to get information on all of your options.
extraction.soa_span: Signing the Scope of Appointment to your email

superlatives.text: The Cigna plan available in Pinellas County has a $0 monthly premium, a $155 drug deductible and a $6300 maximum out-of-pocket.

composition.summary: The call was compliant with the CMS contract year 2027 marketing rules. The disclaimer was delivered and compliant with the ordering:before-benefits basis. The Scope of Appointment was collected and the appointment was scheduled 4 hours after the SOA. No superlatives were flagged.
composition.coaching_note: Agent, you did a great job delivering the required disclaimer before discussing any benefits. However, you could have provided more context for the numeric claims, such as explaining what a $0 monthly premium means in the context of the plans being discussed.
